name: Calc2Pay
tagline: Billing calculator with instant UPI payment QR generation
description: Calc2Pay is a fast, offline-first billing calculator for small shop counters. Ring up an itemized bill, apply discounts, then generate a UPI payment QR code instantly — no card machine, no backend, no monthly fee.
features: Itemized bill builder with quantity, discount and tax
Instant UPI QR code generation for any payable amount
Share bill as image or text in one tap
Works fully offline, no account required

notes: Fixed two real-device bugs found in on-device testing
Initial release: billing calculator + UPI QR payments
